sources.title: Streblus
sources.clean:
Streblus is a genus of flowering plants in the mulberry family, Moraceae. It includes five species native to the Indian subcontinent, Indochina, southern China, and Malesia. 

Species
Five species are currently accepted.
Streblus asper Lour. – Siamese rough bush
Streblus celebensis {{small|[[C.C.Berg]]}}
Streblus mitis {{small|Kurz}}
Streblus vidalii {{small|T.H.Nguyên}}
Streblus monoicus {{small|[[Gagnep.]]}}

Formerly placed here
Paratrophis banksii {{small|Cheeseman}} – large-leaved milk tree (as Streblus banksii {{small|(Cheeseman) C.J.Webb}})
Paratrophis microphylla {{small|(Raoul) Cockayne}} – small-leaved milk tree (as Streblus heterophyllus {{small|(Blume) Corner}})
 Paratrophis pendulina {{small|(Endl.) E.M.Gardner}} – aiai (Eastern Australia, Melanesia, Micronesia, Polynesia) (as Streblus pendulinus (Endl.) F.Muell and Streblus brunonianus {{small|(Endl.) F.Muell.}})
Paratrophis sclerophylla {{small|(Corner) E.M.Gardner}} (as Streblus sclerophyllus Corner)
Paratrophis smithii {{small|Cheeseman}} – Three Kings milk tree (as Streblus smithii {{small|(Cheeseman) Corner}})
Sloetia elongata {{small|(Miq.) Koord.}} (as Streblus elongatus {{small|(Miq.) Corner}})
Taxotrophis ilicifolia {{small|(Kurz) S.Vidal}} (as Streblus ilicifolius (Vidal) Corner)
Taxotrophis taxoides {{small|(B.Heyne ex Roth) Chew ex E.M.Gardner}} (as Streblus taxoides (Roth) Kurz.)
